messages:
Ava: Picking up RFC follow-up: we still have runtime complexity from two mapping formats. I want a schema-first canonical mapper and a tiny compat shim.
Rohit: Sketch the schema please. earlier proposals used "rules" but we need to handle specificity vs priority.
Ava: Agreed. My proposal: explicit specificity + priority + optional fallback_profile per rule. Specificity is computed (layer exact > prefix > regex).
Leah: Danger: regex in hot path is scary. We should compile regexes at load and avoid evaluating them frequently.
Ava: Yes — compile at load into a prebuilt matcher trie. Lookup per layer is then table or single regex test for rare cases.
Rohit: Example (proto-ish):

```
mapper_v1:
  default_profile: "int8-safe"
  rules:
    - id: "attn-fp8"
      match: "layer:attn.*"
      match_type: "prefix"
      profile: "fp8-headwise-v3"
      priority: 20
      fallback_profile: "int8-safe"
    - id: "ffn-int8"
      match: "layer:ffn.*"
      match_type: "regex"
      profile: "int8-conservative"
      priority: 10
```

Tonya: Nice. fallback_profile per rule gives ops a safe switch without changing manifests. Good idea.
DevBot: CI: mapper-compat-tests failing on branch "mapper-canonical" (1 flake) :construction_worker:
Ava: On compatibility: the shim should accept legacy per_shard_map and per_layer_map keys. Translate to rule entries with id set to "legacy:<orig>" and attach source_metadata so we can warn.
Leah: Observability: record resolved_rule_id and effective_profile at runtime. Emit metric counters: mapper.rule_applied{rule_id,profile}.
Rohit: Cache interaction: if two profiles differ only by dtype, we must not evict KV cache unnecessarily. Propose we add mapper_hash_details: "dtype_change:false" or include dtype in hash only if it changes memory layout.
Tonya: Implementation detail: runtime should compute a compact enum per profile so lookup is an array index. No hashmap at hot path.
Ava: Migration plan idea: 1) land schema + shim that logs warnings, 2) ship SDK linter that flags legacy keys, 3) two releases of warning, then drop legacy parser.
Leah: Tests: unit for translation, integration shadow canary 2% traffic for 24h, and a degradation-triggered rollback test (simulate eval drop and ensure orchestrator picks fallback_profile).
Rohit: About specificity vs priority: we'll add deterministic tie-breaker: specificity first, then priority, then rule_id lexicographic. Document it.
Tonya: Edge: customer pins (customer_profile_override) must run after mapper resolution. If a customer pins an older profile, we should honor it but emit a compatibility warning if it conflicts with model default dtype.
Ava: Agree. Add a schema boolean: allow_customer_override (default true). If false, pins are ignored and an audit event emitted.
DevBot: Note: telemetry ticket #3421 will be updated to accept new fields: "resolved_rule_id", "mapper_schema_version", "mapper_hash".
Leah: Perf: measure trie build time for large models (50k layers). If build time > 200ms we need to incrementalize.
Rohit: Ops: add a feature flag to enable mapper_v1 per-customer for testing; SRs can toggle without manifest changes.
Tonya: Docs: migration guide section with automated codemod to convert per_layer_map -> rules.
Ava: Action items: Rohit implement precompile trie + compat shim, Leah add telemetry hooks, Tonya write migration codemod, DevBot update CI job names.
Rohit: I'll open PR and assign reviewers.
Ava: Thanks. If anyone wants to pair on tie-breaker ordering ping me.
Leah: SGTM :thumbsup:
DevBot: Reminder: infra freeze 2025-09-01 00:00 UTC next month  plan merges accordingly.
